get.description: Cheap check that the process is up. Never touches dependencies.
Checks Postgres, Redis and S3. Returns 503 if any dependency is down.

get.summary: Sign-in methods available on this deployment

post.summary: Create a workspace (the caller becomes its owner)

get.summary: A workspace, its settings and my role

patch.summary: Rename a workspace or change its settings

patch.description: Nobody can grant a role above their own; admins cannot change owners; the last owner cannot be demoted (409 LAST_OWNER).

delete.summary: Remove a member, or leave (when userId is yours)
delete.description: Takes effect on the removed user’s next request. The last owner cannot leave.

get.description: 404 unless the signed-in user is the recipient.

post.summary: Accept an invitation addressed to me

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Fuzzy search on name, email and aliases

delete.summary: Remove a person from the directory

get.summary: Audit log, newest first (owners and admins)

post.summary: Create a meeting (upload its recording afterwards)

get.summary: A meeting with its participants and recording

patch.summary: Edit the title, time or participants (members: only meetings they created)

delete.summary: Delete a meeting: hidden at once, recordings and data purged in the background

post.summary: Start a multipart upload of the meeting recording; returns the first part URLs
post.description: The browser PUTs each part to its presigned URL and keeps the ETag response header. Retrying with the same Idempotency-Key returns the same upload with fresh URLs.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Client-generated key; retrying with the same key returns the same upload

post.summary: Fresh presigned URLs for more parts
Complete the upload; the meeting becomes `uploaded` (idempotent)

get.summary: The original recording with a short-lived download URL (owners and admins)
The meeting's current processing run, its steps and progress
get.description: `errorDetail` on steps is included for owners and admins only.

A `text/event-stream`. Each `run.updated` event carries a MeetingProcessing JSON body; the first is sent on connect. A `: heartbeat` comment goes out every 15 s and the stream closes after 15 minutes (EventSource reconnects).

post.summary: Reprocess the recording: start a new run (owners and admins)
post.description: 409 `RUN_ALREADY_ACTIVE` while a run is in progress.

get.summary: Short-lived signed URLs for the normalized audio and its waveform peaks
